name: Airtel Mobile Commerce N.V.
summary: Airtel Mobile Commerce N.V. develops and provides a scaled digital financial services platform. The company offers payments services, mobile commerce, global transfers, loans, savings services, insurance, mobile money wallet services, investments, and global digital card, a virtual prepaid digital card that enables customers to make secure international online payments anywhere through its platform. It serves individuals, businesses, and communities in the telecommunications, digital infrastructure, space communications, financial services, real estate, data centers, and hospitality sectors.
